quotations.old_english: Hit (Italy) belíð Wendelsǽ ymb eall útan búton westannorðan

definitions.meaning: in phrases (or compounds) marking position, to the north-west

source_text: westan-norþan. I. adv. From the north-west. Cf. westan (2) :-- Hit (Italy) belíð Wendelsǽ ymb eall útan búton westannorðan, Ors. 1, 1; Swt. 22, 18. II. in phrases (or compounds) marking position, to the north-west: -- Be-westannorðan ðære byrig, Ors. 1, 1; Swt. 22. 5.
